sourceGallery.stagingNote: The images were collected only for review; private staging coverage is not established.

reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: The source depicts Neo in dark glasses and long coat aiming two guns while standing upon a complex rectangular cyberpunk rooftop/plinth with miniature MATRIX letters. The only Matrix Neo cover inspected depicts a different upright monochrome figure with arms down and a flat/simple base with green Matrix-branded presentation. Pose, base, guns and costume details do not match. Five other textual search results are Asuka/Eva/Rei artworks from the Neon Genesis Evangelion franchise, triggered by substring Neo, and are explicitly not Matrix candidate identities. No catalog-wide historical/alias exclusion was proven.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Manual comparison of pose, sculptural geometry, colors and base; source and R2 cover SHA-256 verified, dHash is only supporting evidence.

identityReview.reason: Current Matrix Neo sculpt distinct; textual substring Neo also retrieved five unrelated Evangelion covers, but catalog-wide absence is not proven.

mediaReview.notes: Creator/studio attribution and promotional marks appear on the source images, and selected published covers may include third-party branding. Do not import, crop, remove marks, replace covers or promote without separate rights review.

decision.nextGate: Investigate historical Matrix aliases and full catalog metadata read-only before any new model approval; preserve rejected same-name and off-franchise candidates as evidence.
